svg.title: Autoscaling
svg.desc: Lunch orders climb from 1,500 to 9,000 a second. Average CPU across 5 servers shoots past the 60 percent target, so 25 new servers boot and join, and CPU settles back to 60 percent. After the rush, traffic falls, CPU drops below target, and the extra servers retire a few at a time.
svg.text: Load rises past the target and new servers join. Load falls, extras retire.
